Package com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.clients

Class ChromaCollectionClient

java.lang.Object
com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.clients.ChromaCollectionClient
@Service public class ChromaCollectionClient extends Object
Service facade for Chroma DB collection operations. Provides a clean API for collection-related operations.
